dialogue_texts: Kaguya
This feels less like a resting place and more like an abandoned backstage.
Kaguya
The scripts are torn, the ink is dry, and yet someone is desperately trying to force a curtain call.
A curtain call? How poetic.
When the current play is a tragedy written by the hands of false gods...
A grand rewrite is the only noble course of action.
Welcome to the epicenter of the rewriting, My Majesty.
Doromi
I am Doromi Akatsuki. Have you come to offer your legendary lineage to our new narrative?
Kaguya
A dhampir acting as an unauthorized scribe. How quaint.
Kaguya
You speak of rewriting history with a few extra brushstrokes altering the deep, unchanging ocean.
Doromi
A paper scrap? This parallel world is a grand canvas, and the Order holds the ink of vengeance!
Doromi
Your continuous, unbroken history is an eyesore.
Doromi
We shall smudge your chapter until nothing remains but a beautiful, red stain.
Kaguya
Many emperors and conquerors have held their brushes before you, my dear.
Kaguya
They swore they would paint over my existence, yet their empires turned to dust as the moon rose each night.
Kaguya
Your 'new narrative' is just a fleeting smudge on my eternal evening.
Doromi
Then let us test the endurance of your endless night!
Doromi
Let us see if your unmoving history can withstand a script that shifts with every strike of my danmaku!
Kaguya
Show me your chaotic poetry, little scribe.
Kaguya
Let us see whose brush leaves a permanent mark upon this night!
Doromi
Prepare to be written out of existence!
